# source: biblatex manual §3.1.1 (the standard styles; style defaults to
# numeric, sorting to nty), §3.1.2.1 (maxcitenames, useprefix, sorting),
# §3.7.1 (\addbibresource), §3.7.2 (\printbibliography), §3.8.2 (the
# citation commands). A style load keeps the one entry model, read through
# biber (Bib.Processor.biber: journaltitle, location, date, urldate, doi,
# eprint, crossref and xdata), and sets the reference list by standard.bbx's
# drivers under its family, numeric or authoryear (Bib.renderBbl, held to
# biber's lines by biblatexOracleChecks); alphabetic and the other families
# are W0353, their list set by the numeric drivers. The citations land on
# the natbib door: \parencite/\autocite onto \citep, \textcite onto
# \citet, authoryear's bare \cite onto \citealp, a capitalized spelling
# onto its capitalized form, authoryear's \parencite* onto \citeyearpar,
# the multicite commands (\cites, \parencites, \textcites, ...) onto one
# citation per key joined by the family's delimiter, and the footnote
# citations (\footcite, \smartcite, \footcites) onto a footnote holding
# the bare citation and its period; \footcitetext is \footnotetext's W0370,
# numeric's superscript \supercite is \cite of its keys with the
# superscript named (W0428), as a style without one falls back to \cite,
# and the field citations (\citetitle, \citeurl, \citedate, \fullcite)
# print the entry's field as biblatex.def formats it. With biblatex's citation
# defaults (Bib.CitePunct.biblatex): up to maxcitenames label names, no von
# part, a textual list's last key after "and", names and lists told apart
# as biber's uniqueness tells them (Bib.uniqueness: uniquename and
# uniquelist, on under authoryear), shortauthor and shorteditor as the
# label names, a shorthand in place of the label, a numeric textual
# citation's keys by one list of names in one bracket, and the list in
# biblatex's nty (numeric) or nyt (authoryear) order; authoryear takes
# natbib's round brackets and semicolons with a space between name and year
# (\nameyeardelim). So each style load is impl; uniquename's and
# uniquelist's per-list variants (mininit, minfull, minyear) are W0101,
# read as their every-list namesakes. Names in biber's extended format
# (family=, given=, prefix=, suffix=, a per-name useprefix) are read as
# biber reads them. A list biblatex words in a language other than
# english.lbx's (babel's main language, language=, autolang's entry
# languages) is set in English and is W0421; a cited @set is W0422, its
# members listed one by one; an entry's related entries are not set and are
# W0423. A citation's post-note takes biblatex's page prefix (p., pp., or
# the entry's pagination). The list sorts by biblatex's nty, nyt, nyvt, ynt
# and ydnt templates (presort, sortkey, sortname, sorttitle, sortyear),
# collated under the sortlocale biber reads (babel's main language under
# auto): a Latin-script tailoring as Unicode::Collate::Locale weighs it, one
# of another script W0427;
# an entry's options (useprefix, skipbib, dataonly, the name counts, the
# use and identifier options) and the load's useauthor, useeditor,
# usetranslator, abbreviate, datecirca and dateuncertain are read; a
# mergedate other than compact is W0104. A remote or non-BibTeX resource
# is W0104, skipped; the legacy preamble \bibliography{refs} is
# \addbibresource{refs.bib}. The resources land on \bibliography, as
# BibTeX's list of files, at the \printbibliography site; \printbibliography
# with no file declared
# draws nothing and says so. The drawn evidence is biblatexChecks',
# biblatexOracleChecks' and biblatexUniqueChecks' lines, measured with
# biber.
pre impl \usepackage[style=numeric]{biblatex}
pre impl \usepackage[style=numeric,sorting=none]{biblatex}
pre impl \usepackage[style=numeric,sorting=ydnt]{biblatex}
pre impl \usepackage[style=authoryear,abbreviate=false,usetranslator=true]{biblatex}
pre refuse:W0104 \usepackage[style=authoryear,mergedate=basic]{biblatex}
pre refuse:W0104 \addbibresource[location=remote]{https://example.org/refs.bib}
pre impl \usepackage[style=authoryear]{biblatex}
pre impl \usepackage[style=authoryear,uniquename=init,uniquelist=false,maxnames=2]{biblatex}
pre refuse:W0101 \usepackage[style=authoryear,uniquename=mininit]{biblatex}
pre refuse:W0353 \usepackage[style=alphabetic]{biblatex}
pre inert:binds \addbibresource{refs.bib}
body inert:no-bib-file \printbibliography
pre inert:binds \bibliography{refs}
body impl \autocite{k}
body impl \Autocite{k}
body impl \parencite{k}
body impl \Parencite{k}
body impl \parencite*{k}
body impl \textcite{k}
body impl \Textcite{k}
body impl \cite{k}
body impl \Cite{k}
body impl \footcite{k}
body impl \Footcite{k}
body impl \smartcite{k}
body impl \Smartcite{k}
body refuse:W0370 \footcitetext{k}
body refuse:W0428 \supercite{k}
body impl \cites{a}{b}
body impl \Cites{a}{b}
body impl \parencites{a}{b}
body impl \Parencites{a}{b}
body impl \textcites{a}{b}
body impl \Textcites{a}{b}
body impl \autocites{a}{b}
body impl \Autocites{a}{b}
body impl \footcites{a}{b}
body impl \smartcites{a}{b}
body impl \fullcite{k}
body impl \footfullcite{k}
body impl \citeauthor{k}
body impl \citeyear{k}
body impl \nocite{k}
body impl \citetitle{k}
body impl \citetitle*{k}
body impl \citeurl{k}
body impl \citedate{k}
